title: dipladenia pohliana
intro: Dipladenia pohliana, commonly known as Mandevilla pohliana, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its large, showy flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The extracts of Dipladenia pohliana are believed to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and antidiabetic activities.
